message: The other night, we had a surprise power outage and I found myself in the dark, fumbling for my flashlight. As I got it working, my family group chat lit up with everyone sharing their own blackout stories and tips. My daughter sent a funny meme about how we should all start a candle-free survival club, while my son reminded us to keep our phones charged with power banks. It turned into a cozy little moment of laughter and support, reminding me just how nice it is to have a plan and a sense of humor! Have you ever had a funny or memorable experience during a blackout?
